title: Tintinnabulum event
description: One thing that happened, described so it can be heard and seen. Only `magnitude` is required: everything else has a defined default, because a source that cannot supply a field should not be forced to invent one.

magnitude.description: How big the event is, in whatever unit the source uses. Drives pitch and size. A negative value carries its own polarity unless `polarity` says otherwise. The engine calibrates itself against the values it sees, so the unit does not have to be normalised or known in advance.

polarity.description: Direction, and therefore which instrument plays: 1 rings, -1 plucks, 0 is neutral. Supply it only when direction means something in your data.

id.description: Stable identity. The same id always lands in the same place on screen, so a thing that happens repeatedly pulses in one spot instead of scattering. Defaults to a generated id, which scatters.

category.description: A free-form bucket that selects colour, and may override the instrument. Any string is valid; the palettes name `user`, `anon`, `bot` and `alert`, and anything else falls back to the palette's default colour rather than disappearing.

accent.description: A rare, notable event: plays the swell, shows a banner, and outranks ordinary events when only one may sound. Mark few things with this, or it stops meaning anything.

label.description: Human-readable text, shown on hover and briefly on arrival. Keep it short, and remember it is displayed: do not put anything here you would not put on a screen unasked.

url.description: Opened when the mark is clicked. Omit it and the mark is not clickable.

ts.description: When it happened, in milliseconds since the epoch. Defaults to the moment of arrival. Supplying a real timestamp is what lets a batch of past events be replayed with their own timing rather than as a metronome.

source.description: Name of whatever produced the event. Informational: it is shown in the activity log and carried through.

data.description: Your original payload, passed through untouched and never interpreted. Whatever the mapping did not use is still here.
